text:
pagerbot: :rotating_light: PAGER — reserved pool `resv-nyc-1` is saturated for tenant NexisCorp. Queue growth ~6x, avg latency 2.8s, throttles at 85%, error spikes. SEV1. Please ack.

Sam (oncall): acked. I'm looking at autoscaler + pool metrics now.

Anya (SRE): seeing repeated scale attempts hitting `max_concurrent_scale=3`. Autoscaler returning 429s from quota API. No new workers coming up.

Mike (Infra): confirmed. Not a cloud quota issue — our dedicated-pool policy is blocking further scale (policy:dedicated-pool-max). Also seeing a bunch of long-running sessions holding many gpus (possible noisy neighbor).

Lina (CS): NexisCorp reported degraded dedicated endpoint performance ~10m ago. Account team on standby.

Sam (oncall): Trying quick mitigations: routing low-priority traffic to fallback model variant and enabling per-tenant throttles for non-critical routes.

Sam (oncall): Running eviction to clear obvious idle/noisy sessions:
```
/bin/resvctl evict --pool resv-nyc-1 --selector tenant!=NexisCorp --older-than 5m --dry-run=false
```

Eric (Runtime): careful with broad evictions — could impact other paid customers. Suggest targeting sessions with `label=dev-session` and long idle times first.

Anya (SRE): autoscaler logs snippet:
```
[autoscaler] 12:34:56 scale_attempt=3 -> limit_reached=true reason=pool_max_reached
[quota] 12:35:01 api_call=reserve_gpus status=429
[kvcache] prefix_hits=low seq_len=512
```

Mike (Infra): I can temporarily allocate +2 GPUs to the pool (emergency override) but need rapid approvals; that buys ~6-8 min. Cost hit noted. What's NexisCorp SLA exposure?

Lina (CS): customer wants ETA and mitigation plan. They asked for a 30min update. Please provide clear steps.

Olga (Product): any recent runtime changes in the last hour? Could be regression.

Eric (Runtime): we shipped a batching/packing heuristic tweak ~22m ago that reduces packing efficiency on long-context sessions. That could inflate slot usage. I'm preparing a rollback.

Sam (oncall): Plan: 1) evict noisy/idle sessions 2) enable tenant-level throttles 3) rollback batching heuristic 4) emergency +2 pool if traffic not improving. Who owns rollback?

Eric (Runtime): I own rollback. @deploy-bot start rollback canary.

deploy-bot: Deploy started: `revert/batching-heuristics` -> canary on `resv-nyc-1`.

Sam (oncall): Lina please draft customer message: acknowledging impact, saying we have mitigations in flight and will follow with RCA.

Lina (CS): message drafted and sent to NexisCorp; account team looped. They want a follow-up postmortem.

Anya (SRE): After evicting ~12 clearly idle/non-tagged sessions and applying throttles, queue dropped ~40% and latency improved to ~1.2s. Still two stuck sessions holding 4 GPUs each.

Sam (oncall): can we force-terminate the suspicious sessions? Need to confirm they're not in-progress model fine-tune/inference jobs for paying tenants.

Mike (Infra): checking session metadata now.

Mike (Infra): output:
```
/bin/sessionctl list --pool resv-nyc-1 --filter 'state=active' --limit 50
# session-8932 (tenant=unknown, gpus=4, age=2h)
# session-9001 (tenant=NexisCorp, gpus=4, age=3h)
```

Anya (SRE): target session-8932 (no tenant tag) for forced termination. Avoid touching NexisCorp session-9001.

Sam (oncall): evicted session-8932 -> freed 4 GPUs. Observed immediate ~25% drop in queue length.

deploy-bot: rollback `revert/batching-heuristics` applied to 30% canary on `resv-nyc-1`. Monitoring telemetry.

Olga (Product): we should schedule a postmortem. Proposal: add per-tenant hard caps + packing regression alerts to prevent this class of issue.

Sam (oncall): current status: queue normalizing, p95 latency trending toward baseline ~0.6s. Autoscaler still at configured cap; follow-up required to review pool ceiling and emergency scale policies.

Lina (CS): NexisCorp updated: performance improving, we will send final update and postmortem. They appreciate the quick response.

incident-bot: Incident created: INC-4021 - Dedicated pool saturation (resv-nyc-1) - impact to NexisCorp.

Anya (SRE): lowering severity to SEV2 if metrics continue improving. Collecting full autoscaler traces and session histories for RCA.

Sam (oncall): action items: Eric -> confirm rollback completes and monitor packing efficiency; Mike -> propose emergency pool override + policy changes; Anya -> gather traces & metrics; Lina -> final customer postmortem & timeline. I'll keep thread open for 1h for any regressions.

Sam (oncall): nice work team. :thumbsup:
